item.tib: rgyal 'phags rgyal sa rgya mtsho'i dbus / rgyal rigs klu rgyal thar par drangs / rgyal bstan gsal ba'i gsas khang bzhengs / rgyud rgyal man ngag gzungs chen
item.note: at the end of this section is a brief colophon by the compiler of the collection: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni bdag gis mos gus kyi sgo nas skyid mkhar ri zhing dgon pa rtse la / nyi zla gza' skar bzang po'i nyi shar rtse la sgrig pa'i dge ba'i 'gro kun gsang sngags don rtogs shog … compare the compiler's colophon at the end of text no. 38.31.
